semantic_review: Root read original Python, all six final finite modules and the retained typed host/scalar routes reviewed in the pinned predecessor. The source runtime n_elements is explicitly i32 and BLOCK_SIZE is 1024. Concrete bitvector arithmetic and pointer sign-extension agree with the natural model throughout the stated bounded source domain, including padded lanes. Every physical source batch loads both actual input views before stores, uses the concrete existing per-route scalar expressions, and connects its output to the independently stated result of actual existing typed grid execution. Fresh allocation separates all output cells; inputs may alias each other. Distinct output cells, full input/raw byte frames and arbitrary complete active-lane schedule invariance are proved. Actual metadata queries bind base, extent, data pointer, storage offset, preserve-format output strides, alignment, device and permissions. The final domain no longer requires y.numel>=x.numel when its backing span suffices. Source-order fallible allocation and CUDA assertion precede exact canonical frontend dispatch. All189 admitted routes and100 first rejection cases remain. Undefined active floating-to-integer conversions are excluded structurally from successful applicability, with no invented output or native trap/rollback claim; concrete typed integer semantics are not numerical deferrals. Numeric correspondence binds exactly the used scalar/cast ports and their exceptional/rounding domain; empty/error cases use no numerical callback. Root independently replayed all289 frontend profiles and all view/metadata/schedule/index probes, and independently checked all616 omitted-port mutations. This establishes source-level acceptance under the explicit finite API/primitive boundary, conditional on exact numerical registrations and successful active integration build; it does not establish native compiler/GPU/numerical conformance.

metadata_baseline.review: Complete unchanged pre-extension metadata checker passes against all pinned committed public sources. Live metadata remains exactly these bytes; no public scan is skipped.
